It does not fire on running prose: ordinary space-separated content words ('the river', 'the plan', 'the framework') stay within +-0.2 mid-document and prose sources fire on only 0.3-1.2% of tokens, so its prose top examples ('Data breaches...', 'Business Cycle Accounting...', 'Mexico shaken...') are all document openings, where the first-token floor still lifts positions 1-2 (18% active there versus 2.7% at later positions).
